name: io.github.fetchsandbox/mcp
description: A deterministic verification engine for agents. Proves a fix: fails on the old code, passes on new.
title: FetchSandbox

environmentVariables.name: FETCHSANDBOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Sign in without a browser — useful in CI. Left unset, the server runs anonymously and asks you to sign in the first time a run produces a receipt.
Set to '0' to disable anonymous usage telemetry.
environmentVariables.name: FETCHSANDBOX_TELEMETRY

environmentVariables.description: Override the FetchSandbox backend base URL (defaults to https://fetchsandbox.com). Useful for stage/self-hosted testing.
environmentVariables.name: FETCHSANDBOX_BASE_URL
